stock.description: Min Fu International Holding Limited is an investment holding firm based in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China, specializing in advanced 3D precision testing and machining services. The company offers sophisticated non-contact optical measurement systems for comprehensive object shape and appearance data analysis and full-field positioning. Additionally, it provides three-dimensional dynamic measurement systems designed to compute surface displacement and strain distribution. Its services are utilized by equipment manufacturers across critical sectors, including aviation, aerospace, shipbuilding, ground transportation vehicles, and electronics. Established in 2017, the company operated as Zhicheng Technology Group Ltd. until April 2022, when it rebranded to Min Fu International Holding Limited.
